mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate amitriptyline's anticholinergic and cardiac effects, while amitriptyline may increase orthostatic hypotension risk with thiazide diuretics.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and sodium) regularly; educate patient on orthostatic precautions; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent if hypokalemia develops.
